title: Why Do We Get Cavities?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Get Cavities.
They make acid that can nibble enamel.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Brushing and flossing break up that film.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
A dentist catch early beats a big ache later.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Mouth bacteria eat leftover sugar.
The pictures today are a new tooth world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we get cavities.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
